children: Quantum computing firm's Q3 revenue fell short of analyst expectations
Company reported Q3 operating loss of $33.2 mln
Company signed $100 mln R&D agreement with US Department of Commerce
Rigetti expects 2026 revenue of about $20 mln, contingent on C-DAC customer acceptance
SYSTEM PERFORMANCE - Co said Q3 progress included achieving 99.5% median two-qubit gate fidelity on its 108-qubit system, validating its chiplet-based architecture
GOVERNMENT CONTRACT - Co signed $100 mln R&D agreement with U.S. Department of Commerce to support technology development
TECHNOLOGY SPEED - Co highlighted gate speeds of 50-70 nanoseconds for its superconducting systems, citing competitive advantage over other modalities
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 9 "strong buy" or "buy", 4 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the semiconductors peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Rigetti Computing, Inc. is $25.00, about 92.6% above its November 9 closing price of $12.98
